name: Reactive Partner-Chase Start
setup: Open floor or a track, cones at the distance.
cues: Go on a point or a call from a partner, not on your own count.
Start a metre behind the partner. When they go, chase and tag them before the cone.
Lean and push the floor back behind you, like pushing a car.

faults.fault: Reaching out in front with each stride
faults.fix: Strike the floor right under you, quick and light.
Punch the arms cheek to back pocket, fast and loose.

cautions: Full warm-up first; stop the set when the speed drops.
